nom: LANEIGE Cream Skin Toner & Moisturizer: Lightweight Refillable Korean Milky Toner with Ceramide & Peptide for Hydration

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some who call it chronically dry, tight or unresponsive to other treatments, report the toner brought lasting hydration and resolved stubborn dry patches that other products and dermatologist-recommended routines had not fixed.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive or eczema-prone skin, including some sensitized by over-exfoliation or retinoids, report no burning, redness or breakouts; one reviewer, however, describes her skin turning red with hives and a burning sensation that persisted on repeat use.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, dry on the cheeks and oily in the T-zone, report the toner evened out their skin and resolved painful, peeling dry patches without disrupting the oilier areas.
segments.oily: Reports from reviewers with oily-leaning skin are mixed: some say it works even in oily or humid conditions, while others found it a little too rich, sticky or oily-feeling, and one warns it is not recommended for oily or fungal-acne-prone skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s, 50s and beyond report the product suits mature skin well, describing softer, plumped-looking skin without the stripping feel of other toners.

concerns.dehydration: This is the near-universal benefit reported: reviewers across skin types describe deep, lasting hydration from a lightweight, milky texture, often replacing the need for a separate moisturizer.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers, including several with sensitive skin, report no redness, itching or irritation even alongside retinoids; one reviewer, however, reports her skin turned red and developed hives with a burning sensation that persisted across repeated uses.
concerns.barrier: Multiple reviewers credit the ceramides and peptides with supporting or strengthening their skin barrier, some specifically using it to offset dryness from tretinoin or other retinoids.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including some with a long history of acne, report no new breakouts; one reviewer with fungal acne says it flared up after use and advises against it for fungal-acne-prone or oily skin, and another notes the rich formula could theoretically smother non-dry skin, though she personally didn't break out.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers mostly describe the finish as non-oily and non-sticky once absorbed, but a few with oily skin found it left a slightly oily or tacky feel and suggest it suits drier skin types better.
concerns.aging: A few reviewers report visibly plumped skin and reduced fine lines, particularly under the eyes, though one notes the peptides sit low on the ingredient list and work better as a light bonus than as a dedicated anti-aging treatment.

extraits.texte: I take pride in maintaining healthy-looking skin. To transition to a no-makeup look, I wanted to add a touch of dewyness. At 40, I prioritize skincare over makeup. That’s when I discovered this product. However, it felt like it was burning my skin! Initially, it appeared lovely, giving me that glass-like glow. But after an hour or so, my skin turned red and developed hives. I initially thought it was an interaction with my vitamin F serum, so I used it again on its own after a few days to test my theory. Unfortunately, the burning sensation persisted. Regrettably, this product didn’t work for me.

extraits.titre: Great product but came damaged and possibly old.
extraits.texte: I got a small sample of this product from Sephora and it’s been one of the only brands/products that doesn’t make me break out and does wonders for my skin. However, I received it extremely damaged and I’m skeptical it may be an old product. It came in an envelope so I’m honestly not very shocked it was damaged but it had a cream-like consistency on the bottle and if you’ve used this product, you know it’s a watery-liquid kind of consistency which is what makes me believe it may be old. I also looked up the batch code and one website was saying April 2023 the other website was saying January 2024. The product leaked everywhere and was about a quarter to nearly half of the way gone. The box is dirty and beat up and the bottle is bent at the bottom and sits a little slanted. Though it came in an envelope the box looks very dirty and old and the envelope was not damaged at all. I’m very disappointed that this is my first experience purchasing the full sized product.

I've never been able to find a moisturizer that wouldn't clog my pores anytime I used it, even in moderation. I have combo skin, dry everywhere beside my t-zone. This moisturizer, is an ACTUAL game changer!!! I bought one a little under 2 weeks ago on prime-day and I have been using it ever since. My skin has never looked this good, and stayed looking this good. A few days ago, I bought another one of these as a gift for my mother since she has given me nonstop compliments about my skin. Treat yourself, you will not regret it! p.s. A LITTLE GOES A LONG WAY!!! Be careful dripping it out, you can get more than you wanted, so take it easy.

“I’ve been using this milky toner morning and night for about a week, and overall I think it’s a great product to give your skin that extra hydration it needs. One thing I really liked is how thin it is and how just a little bit goes a long way. It drastically reduces the appearance of my fine lines under my eyes because it is THAT hydrating. The best part? It doesn’t irritate my skin like other toners and is good to use if you are on tretinoin or another retinol. One downside is that it is a little pricey and a little sticky after putting it on your face, but it is not a big deal if you put a little moisturizer on top. Overall, I’d recommend this for anyone who is looking to keep their skin extra hydrated without putting a thick/heavy cream all over their face.

I originally bought the Rhode glazing milk but as someone with super sensitive and eczema prone skin, that made me break out horribly. I bought the mini milky toner of this product and honestly love it! It’s rather thin consistency but feels hydrating and gives your skin a glow. I’ve been using it for about 4 days and haven’t had any breakouts
